meta.sampling: Sentiment records are a purposive sample of public, attributable statements gathered via OnDemand research plugins (Perplexity, GPT Search, Internet search, Reddit/HN pages surfaced by those tools) between 2025-08 and 2026-10-20. It is NOT a population survey and does not measure national opinion.
